items.prompt: No bad closer, but openers remain. Report which?

options.why: The latest unmatched opener is at the stack top, but the specified end-of-line error uses the earliest one.
The final character may be ordinary text or a matched closer, not the opener that the contract asks to report.
With no earlier bad closer, the remaining stack bottom is the earliest unmatched opener and supplies the required position.
Nonbrackets are ignored for matching, although they still count toward character positions.

items.explanation: The public end-of-line rule uses stack bottom.
